approval_authority.instruction: Ok let's add it as an approved model
approval_authority.basis: User approval following separate-agent review and native/Wasm qualification; no human reviewer credentials or signature inferred

definition.immutable_identity_policy: Approval is attached to exact tested bytes. Embedded historical draft metadata is preserved; the approval status is authoritative in this registry for the declared scope.

scope.law: continuous Maxwell deviatoric viscoelasticity with elastic volumetric response
scope.use: bounded material-point use supported by the exact frozen qualification cases and example settings

conditions.MW-14: closed by exact durable private source retention; source-retention.json receipt

limitations: Approved scope is limited to the named frozen cases/settings; broad declared parameter ranges and arbitrary solver tolerances are not qualified.
Continuous dissipation is not an unconditional numerical energy guarantee; loose permitted midpoint tolerances can admit artificial growth.
Saved schedule failure tests cover t=0 entry rollback, not failure after a nonzero-time regular sample.
No experimental calibration/prediction, FE/MPM host qualification, saturation/pore-pressure coupling or finite-rotation objectivity.
No vendor central-difference algorithm, complete vendor example/host equivalence or Jaeger first-publication reconciliation.
Browser timed-control UI and release/deployment qualification are outside this approval.
